entities.name: Split of Muscat and Zanzibar
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The death of Sultan Said and the division of the empire between his sons — Thuwaini receiving Muscat and Oman, Majid receiving Zanzibar, with the Canning Award formalizing the split.
